name: record-page
summary: A supplier record: identity band, tabs with counts, editable properties, related tables and an activity feed.
ports: id: the supplier id from the route
supplier: the supplier record, or undefined for the not-found frame
records: the related orders, parts and notes query state, typed QueryStateLike with data?: SupplierRecords
now: the reading time in ms, for countdowns, relative times and the activity feed
partsHref: NavTarget, the parent link of the PageBar
recordHref: NavTarget, this record's own link, the favourite target
partHref: (partId) => NavTarget, the link of each relationship card
newOrder: (dialog: NewOrderSlot) => ReactNode, renders the create flow with supplier, open and onOpenChange
export recordControls: the tab and order URL fields; the route wires validateSearch and middlewares
